rows.statement: Approval for modifications to Physician and Patient Labeling.
Approval for a change to the annual re-validation of the dry heat sterilization process to allow annual re-validation to be performed without biological indicators every other year.
Approval for changes to the patient and physician labeling including a boxed warning and a patient decision checklist.
Installation of a new patch curing oven and electronic data acquisition system for the manufacture of silicone-filled and saline-filled breast implants at Allergan's Costa Rica facility.

Change to implement new temperature controllers used in the alcohol shell drying ovens in the manufacturing process of the Allergan Natrelle® Saline-Filled Breast Implants and the Allergan Natrelle® Silicone-Filled Breast Implants

Change to implement an Electronic Data Acquisition (EDA) System to record and store the cycle parameters of the dry heat sterilization process used in the manufacture of Allergan Natrelle® Saline-Filled Breast Implants and Allergan Natrelle® Silicone-Filled Breast Implants
Addition of new ovens used in the manufacturing process of NATRELLE Silicone-Filled Breast Implants.
Addition of an alternative detection method for the Quality Control bacterial endotoxin testing of the finished devices.
Implementing changes to the gel filling process, specifically, changing from manual filling to an automated process.
Replace paper chart recorders and to use an electric heating module rather than water to heat the air in the carousel room.

Approval to implement an additional incoming specification, i.e., verify the color of the gel material by using the Ultra Scan VIS Sensor System to confirm that the gel color does not change between shipment and receipt. There are no changes to existing incoming specification, manufacturing process, and final device specifications.  The addition of this assessment is specific to the 900 Parkway Global Park, La Aurora, Heredia, Costa Rica manufacturing site.

Implement an Electronic Data Acquisition (EDA) System to collect cycle parameter, such as temperature and time, for the shell drying after washing and gel curing after shell filling occur in the Blue-M oven. The above change is located 900 Parkway Global Park, La Aurora, Heredia, Costa Rica.
Approval of a planned manufacturing capacity expansion at the Costa Rica manufacturing facility and the addition of manufacturing equipment.

Approval for changes to the labeling including 1) the removal of the Betadine warning against breast implant exposure to Betadine brand povidone-iodine 10% (applicable to generic versions as well) from the patient and physician labeling; and 2) modifications to the language in the physician and patient labeling regarding the potential risk of breast implant associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma (BIA-ALCL).
Change to Limulous Amoebocyte Lysate (LAL) reagent sensitivity
Addition of two new Gruenberg gel curing ovens.

Implement an Electronic Data Acquisition (EDA) System for the shell assembly vulcanization process to collect and store temperature, pressure, and time data. The above change is located 900 Parkway Global Park, La Aurora, Heredia, Costa Rica.
Approval for minor design modifications to previously approved packaging configurations and the use of this packaging with additional devices.
Approval for 10 styles of the Natrelle Inspira® SoftTouch Silicone-Filled Breast Implants.
Change in the method for bioburden monitoring.

Approval for adding a new mixing specification of ± 2.5 % (by weight) for theplatinum silicone catalyst (Part A) and cross-linked siloxane (Part B) weights, noting that weights vary based on the size of the production run to produce the standard dispersion (P/N 200-003) and the barrier dispersion (P/N 200-004) during the production of breast implant shells.
Approval for Inspira Cohesive Silicone-Filled Breast Implants filled with highly cohesive silicone gel.
Approval for removal of the DSMB from the BIFS-001 study protocol.

rows.statement: APPROVAL FOR A TRADE NAME CHANGE FROM INAMED SILICONE-FILLED BREAST IMPLANTS TO NATRELLE SILICONE-FILLED BREAST IMPLANTS.  THE DEVICE, AS MODIFIED, WILL BE MARKETED UNDER THE TRADE NAME NATRELLE SILICONE-FILLED BREAST IMPLANTS AND IS INDICATED FOR BREAST AUGMENTATION FOR WOMEN AT LEAST 22 YEARS OLD AND FOR BREAST RECONSTRUCTION FOR WOMEN OF ANY AGE.  BREAST AUGMENTATION INCLUDES PRIMARY BREAST AUGMENTATION TO INCREASE THE BREAST SIZE, AS WELL AS REVISION SURGERY TO CORRECT OR IMPROVE THE RESULT OF A PRIMARY BREAST AUGMENTATION SURGERY.  BREAST RECONSTRUCTION INCLUDES PRIMARY RECONSTRUCTION TO REPLACE BREAST TISSUE THAT HAS BEEN REMOVED DUE TO CANCER OR TRAUMA OR THAT HAS FAILED TO DEVELOP PROPERLY DUE TO A SEVERE BREAST ABNORMALITY.  BREAST RECONSTRUCTION ALSO INCLUDES REVISION SURGERY TO CORRECT OR IMPROVE THE RESULT OF A PRIMARY BREAST RECONSTRUCTION SURGERY.

On July 24, 2019, Allergan issued a press release related to the recall was posted on the Allergan website (Allergan.com). Recall letters were sent on August 6, 2019 via: FedEx overnight mail with tracking to all consignees who may have product within expiry. 

The recall letter will inform customers to do the following:
1.	If you have inventory of the recalled products, Quarantine product to prevent its use. 
2.	Conduct a physical count of the affected products in your possession and record the count on the enclosed Recall Stock Response Form.
3.	Send the Recall Stock Response Form to Inmar Rx Solutions, Inc via fax or email within five (5) business days of receipt. To ensure we are able to account for all recalled product, it is imperative that you return the form.
4.	Upon receipt of the Response Form, Inmar will issue Return Authorization label(s).
5.	When returning the recalled products, attach the prepaid FedEx Authorized Return shipping label to the outside of the return carton and return the recalled product to:
Inmar Rx Solutions, Inc.
4332 Empire Rd. Fort Worth, TX 76155
6.	Please Do Not return any products that are not the subject of this recall. 
Please contact Inmar Rx Solutions, Inc. if you have any questions about these recall actions.

noticeCandidates.title: UPDATE: Reports of Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) in the Capsule Around Breast Implants - FDA Safety Communication
noticeCandidates.review: class-context: Breast-implant capsule cancers; no model/lot-specific recall is established by this communication. This is class-level surveillance information, not proof that a particular Natrelle style caused SCC.

noticeReviews.scope: Breast-implant capsule cancers; no model/lot-specific recall is established by this communication.
noticeReviews.finding: FDA describes rare SCC reports with unknown incidence, cause and risk factors, distinct from BIA-ALCL; asymptomatic removal solely for this concern is not recommended.
noticeReviews.limitation: This is class-level surveillance information, not proof that a particular Natrelle style caused SCC.
noticeReviews.locator: Affected Product; What to Do; Reason for Recall/Correction

noticeReviews.scope: Allergan BIOCELL textured implant and tissue-expander products identified in July 2019.
noticeReviews.finding: The recall addresses BIA-ALCL risk associated with the named textured products. It is not a recall of every smooth Natrelle implant; FDA did not recommend removal in asymptomatic patients.
noticeReviews.limitation: Use the implant card and full product table; individual risk and symptoms require clinical assessment.

limits: Recall API coverage begins in 2002; earlier recalls are not exhaustively covered. Malformed direct identifiers are excluded from accepted joins and shown separately for review.
Only root pma_numbers/k_numbers used for joins; recognized PMA supplements normalize to their parent application. Harmonized manufacturer identifiers and name similarity are excluded.
FDA notice index pages for 2023–2026 screened by explicit product/class terms; pre-2023 web archives and manufacturer notices not exhaustively reviewed.

Source-field audits and notice-scope decisions are distinct from clinical signoff or patient/unit matching. FDA recall status is as reported in the dated snapshot. MAUDE and enforcement reconciliation are outside this review.

labelReview.scope: Current US Natrelle public safety information; original Inamed and later surface variants distinguished

findings.text: Breast implants are not lifetime devices; reoperation, rupture and capsular contracture are important risks. The safety information includes a boxed warning and implant-associated lymphoma, more commonly reported with textured implants.
findings.locator: Boxed Warning; BIA-ALCL; rupture screening; complications

findings.text: For asymptomatic silicone implants the manufacturer recommends initial ultrasound or MRI at 5–6 years, then every 2–3 years; symptoms or uncertain ultrasound findings require separate evaluation.
findings.locator: Boxed Warning; BIA-ALCL; rupture screening; complications

sources.title: Natrelle manufacturer safety information
sources.locator: Boxed Warning; BIA-ALCL; rupture screening; complications
sources.method: Editorial inspection of publicly retrieved primary-source text/excerpts; indexed age can differ from access date. Full current IFU certification is separate.

limitations: This public safety page is not a complete model-specific IFU. BIOCELL textured-device recall scope must not be applied indiscriminately to smooth implants; exact style and implant card remain necessary.

review.method: Primary-source, model-scoped editorial review. Current public safety statements are distinguished from historical labels and full IFUs. No clinical certification or patient-specific applicability determination.
